# LiteX

> LiteX is a Python framework (built on Migen) to create FPGA cores and SoCs: a SoC builder with
> Wishbone/AXI/CSR interconnect and streams, in-tree cores, soft and hard CPUs, build backends for
> the vendor and open-source FPGA toolchains and for Verilator, a BIOS and software support, host
> bridges and debug tools, plus an ecosystem of cores (LiteDRAM, LiteEth, LitePCIe, LiteSATA,
> LiteSDCard, LiteICLink, LiteJESD204, LiteSPI, LiteI2C, LiteScope). BSD-2-Clause, by
> Enjoy-Digital and the LiteX community. Repository: https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex

This file indexes the LiteX wiki. The raw markdown of a page is at
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/enjoy-digital/litex/<Page-Name>.md (sources: doc/wiki/ in
the repository). Pages marked TODO are placeholders being written.

## Welcome

- [Home](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Home): what LiteX is, the design flow diagram, where to go next, the ecosystem, examples, quick start, community
- [Installation](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Installation): install LiteX with litex_setup.py (venv, configs minimal/standard/full, --gcc, --update/--tag), build a board target or litex_sim, uninstall, troubleshooting
- [LiteX-Approach](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/LiteX-Approach): how LiteX is built and used: Python + Migen, cores with stable stream/bus/CSR contracts, portable layering, simulation first, bridges and LiteScope on hardware, practical rules, releases
- [Cores-Ecosystem](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Cores-Ecosystem): the Lite* cores (LiteDRAM, LiteEth, LitePCIe, LiteNVMe, LiteSATA, LiteSDCard, LiteICLink, LiteJESD204, LiteSPI, LiteI2C, LiteScope, LiteDSP): standards, supported hardware, standalone generators
- [OSes-Ecosystem](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/OSes-Ecosystem): what runs on a LiteX SoC: BIOS and bare metal, Zephyr/FreeRTOS/NuttX, MicroPython/Rust/MQuickJS, Linux (VexRiscv-SMP, NaxRiscv, VexiiRiscv, Rocket, hard CPUs), upstream drivers, simulation
- [Tutorials-Resources](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Tutorials-Resources): tutorials, workshops, example projects, blog posts and talks
- [Projects](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Projects): industrial and open-source projects built with LiteX
- [Feedback-Contribution-Support](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Feedback-Contribution-Support): how to report an issue (what to include), contribute a pull request, get support
- [Contributing-to-the-Wiki](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Contributing-to-the-Wiki): the wiki is generated from doc/wiki in the repository, how to edit it, links, images, diagrams
- [LiteX-for-Hardware-Engineers](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/LiteX-for-Hardware-Engineers): an introduction to LiteX for engineers used to Verilog and Vivado (2018, by bunnie)

## Internals

- [Cores](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Cores): TODO, the in-tree cores of litex/soc/cores
- [CPUs](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/CPUs): the soft CPUs (VexRiscv, VexiiRiscv, NaxRiscv, Rocket, Microwatt, SERV, ...), their variants and options, --cpu-type/--cpu-variant
- [Hard-core-CPUs](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Hard-core-CPUs): hard CPUs: Zynq-7000, ZynqMP, EOS S3, Gowin EMCU/AE350
- [Wishbone-Bus](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Wishbone-Bus): the Wishbone bus in LiteX SoCs
- [AXI-Bus](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/AXI-Bus): AXI/AXI-Lite in LiteX SoCs
- [CSR-Bus](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/CSR-Bus): the CSR bus: control/status registers, addressing, csr_data_width, the software API
- [Streams](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Streams): LiteX streams (valid/ready/first/last/payload/param) and their relation to AXI-Stream/Avalon-ST
- [Host-Bridges](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Host-Bridges): TODO, UARTBone/JTAGBone/Etherbone/PCIe bridges, litex_server and litex_cli
- [Build-Backends](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Build-Backends): TODO, platforms, vendor and open-source toolchains, --toolchain
- [SoC-builder](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/SoC-builder): TODO, SoCCore, the bus/CSR/IRQ handlers, the add_* API and the Builder
- [SoC-Simulator](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/SoC-Simulator): litex_sim, simulating a full SoC with Verilator
- [SoC-Documentation](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/SoC-Documentation): generating the register-level documentation of a SoC (--doc, sphinx, SVD)
- [FPGA-and-SPI-Flash-programmers](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/FPGA-and-SPI-Flash-programmers): OpenOCD, openFPGALoader and vendor programmers

## How to

- [Create-A-minimal-SoC](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Create-A-minimal-SoC): TODO
- [Add-A-New-Board](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Add-A-New-Board): TODO, platform and target files for LiteX-Boards
- [Add-A-New-Core](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Add-A-New-Core): WIP, pointers to example pull requests adding a core
- [Add-A-New-CPU](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Add-A-New-CPU): WIP, pointers to example pull requests adding a CPU
- [Reuse-a-SystemVerilog-VHDL-Amaranth-Spinal-HDL-Chisel-core](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Reuse-a-SystemVerilog-VHDL-Amaranth-Spinal-HDL-Chisel-core): integrating an existing Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL/Amaranth/SpinalHDL/Chisel core in a LiteX SoC (Instance, litex_read_verilog)
- [Use-LiteX-on-the-Acorn-CLE-215](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Use-LiteX-on-the-Acorn-CLE-215): a repurposed mining board as a PCIe/SATA/Linux LiteX platform
- [Load-Application-Code-To-CPU](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Load-Application-Code-To-CPU): the BIOS boot methods: ROM, serial, Ethernet (TFTP), SPI flash, SD card/SATA
- [Create-And-Load-Software-To-The-CPU](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Create-And-Load-Software-To-The-CPU): TODO
- [Use-Host-Bridge-to-control-debug-a-SoC](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Use-Host-Bridge-to-control-debug-a-SoC): add a UART/JTAG/Ethernet/PCIe bridge, litex_server, litex_cli, scripting register and memory accesses from the host
- [Use-LiteScope-To-Debug-A-SoC](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Use-LiteScope-To-Debug-A-SoC): capture internal signals with the LiteScope logic analyzer through a bridge
- [JTAG-GDB-Debugging-with-VexRiscv-CPU](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/JTAG-GDB-Debugging-with-VexRiscv-CPU): OpenOCD + GDB on a VexRiscv SoC
- [JTAG-GDB-Debugging-with-VexRiscv-SMP-NaxRiscv-VexiiRiscv-CPUs](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/JTAG-GDB-Debugging-with-VexRiscv-SMP-NaxRiscv-VexiiRiscv-CPUs): OpenOCD + GDB on VexRiscv-SMP, NaxRiscv and VexiiRiscv SoCs
- [Document-a-SoC](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex/wiki/Document-a-SoC): TODO, see SoC-Documentation
